applies_why: The judge text counts cited verses toward a broken link without quoting the earlier-round sentence pressing them against that link and without naming that round.
quote: CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN -- [L1] Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost" and Matthew 1:25 "knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son" contradict C3's claim of espousal union
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way.
room: "counts toward a broken link": reading 1, only an express unanswered-witness count triggers it; reading 2, any verse used to support a broken link triggers it.
why: The judge counts Matthew 1:18 and 25 toward a broken link without quoting the earlier-round pressing sentence or naming the round, and [L3] Luke 1:34 has no written ground.
